title: Analytics event workflow
responsibility: Resolves project and loop context, records local analytics events, fingerprints JSON-compatible values, and validates report references.

inputs.name: projectIdentity.root
inputs.description: Checkout or project directory used to resolve the canonical primary worktree path.

inputs.name: resolvedContext.context
inputs.description: Requested loop, step, task, agent model and report analytics context.

inputs.name: resolvedContext.root
inputs.description: Repository root used to read loop state when a loop is selected.

inputs.name: recordAnalytics.event
inputs.description: Analytics fields excluding generated ID, timestamp and project identity.

inputs.name: recordAnalytics.root
inputs.description: Project root to identify; defaults to the process working directory.

inputs.name: fingerprint.value
inputs.description: JSON-serializable value whose serialized bytes are hashed.

inputs.name: validateReport.context
inputs.description: Analytics context; a present report ID is syntax-checked and must name a readable report manifest.

outputs.name: projectIdentity
outputs.description: Canonical primary worktree path, falling back to the resolved input directory when Git identity cannot be read.

outputs.name: resolvedContext
outputs.description: Context with environment defaults applied and, when selected, the loop model and run timestamp filled from loop state.

outputs.name: recordAnalytics
outputs.description: Resolves after attempting local insertion; storage errors are caught and reported as a console warning, and analytics-disabled mode is a no-op.

outputs.name: validateReport
outputs.description: Resolves when no report is selected or its ID and manifest are valid and readable.

errors.name: Invalid analytics context
errors.description: resolvedContext rejects mutually exclusive task/loop context, step without loop, or a step absent from loop state

errors.name: Invalid report reference
errors.description: validateReport rejects a malformed report ID or a missing/unreadable manifest

errors.name: JSON serialization failure
errors.description: fingerprint requires a value JSON.stringify can serialize to a string; cyclic values throw and undefined is not accepted by the hash update
